√ C. 124-5. Padmapurāṇa. Follows fairly closely the recension published in the A.S.S.. Divided as follows:
(i) Bhūmikh., [in 116 sargas] ff. 1-184, Saṃv. 1892; property of Śrīmatāvi[?]ya Bāla mukunda of Benares : (ii) Svargakh., [pūrvārdha] in 62 sargas,
ff. 1-86, Saṃv. 1893; ⟦[illegible]⟧corresponds to A.S.S.'s Ādikh. ⟦[illegible]⟧(iii) Svargakh., uttarārdha, in 26 sargas, ff. 1-31, Saṃv. 1893;
corresponds to A.S.S.'s Brahmakh. : (iv) Uttarakh., ff. 1-407 (29 ff. m.), Saṃv. 1880.
1823-1836 : 301+378 : 12[/?]14 : D.
